nodes.name: COMPLETE SYSTEMS → Document Processing AI Webhook

parameters.content:
WHAT IT DOES:

Classifies document text, extracts key information, and flags missing or risky content.

HOW IT DOES IT:

Accepts documents through a manual trigger or webhook, identifies the document type, extracts amounts, dates, emails, and key lines, then returns a structured JSON summary.

WHY PAY FOR IT:

Reduces manual document review, catches incomplete records, and converts unstructured business documents into automation-ready data within seconds.
